text:
lena: quick idea 1: add a lightweight 'semaphore' safety to runtime flags that caps concurrent activations per cohort. stops rapid mass flips that blow up quotas/routing.

josh: how is "semaphore" different than a simple rate limit? tokens vs activations?

lena: it's per-flag per-cohort activation tokens. small burst then backoff. key point: enforced in-runtime (local token-bucket) so we avoid extra RPCs on the hot path.

ravi: runtime enforcement sounds good for perf, but what happens to callers when the semaphore is exhausted? queue or fail?

lena: fail-fast with Retry-After header. Console surface explains "throttled by safety". Owners can request a temporary override with justification.

maya: UX asks: show current token usage, recent backoffs, last blocked request id, and a one-click dry-run link. Also require 2FA + owner role to force-enable.

devon: from ops: metric names proposal: config.activation_rate, config.throttle_count, config.override_requests, config.override_approvals. Alerts on sustained throttle_count > 5/min for prod cohorts.

cara: SRE: default fail-mode depends on risk: for infra-critical flags fail-closed, for UI flags fail-open. Add emergency safemode bypass only available to oncall with audit log + TTL. Backoff schedule suggestion: [10s, 30s, 120s, 600s].

josh: implementation note: token-bucket in runtime cache; on miss fallback to a tiny circuit-check RPC to config service. We need micro-benchmarks: expected overhead ~1% p95 at 10k rps if optimized.

lena: sample flag + semaphore snippet (dry-run):

```json
{
  "flag": "enable_preflight_path",
  "semaphore": {
    "cap_per_cohort": 10,
    "burst": 50,
    "backoff_seconds": [10, 30, 120, 600],
    "mode": "fail-fast",
    "override_policy": "owner_only",
    "owners": ["devon", "lena"]
  }
}
```

configbot: preflight: schema OK. WARNING: telemetry hooks missing (config.throttle_count). Auto-insert telemetry is recommended.

ravi: strong +1 to auto-insert telemetry scaffolding. we should fail preflight if a semaphore-enabled flag has no telemetry.

maya: Console copy suggestion when throttled: short explanation + "why this happened" + recommended steps + "open dry-run" button. keep language non-technical for PMs.

josh: concur. Also add a timeline view: activations vs blocked events so engineers can correlate with deploys.

devon: I'll draft SLI thresholds today and propose alerting windows. My starting point: alert when throttle_count > 20 in 5m AND activation_rate drops by >20% vs baseline.

cara: I'll author a safemode runbook: how to audit overrides, revoke safemode, and postmortem checklist. include RBAC + TTL for overrides.

josh: I'll put together the perf harness and bench the token-bucket in the runtime.

lena: action items: lena -> RFC + PoC; josh -> perf; devon -> SLIs/alerts; cara -> safemode runbook; maya -> console mocks and copy. reconvene after PoC.

configbot: reminder: create RFC doc under /eng/flags/rfcs and link the preflight id 1790123456.

lena: thanks team :rocket:
